security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: naiteh is a local-first desktop app for Markdown notes and a daily journal. Notes are plain .md files on your disk, browsable by folder, tag, and an Agenda-style calendar timeline, with Git-backed Sync/Backup and an opt-in AI Assist panel.
